points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 塞利姆出生于特拉布宗，是巴耶济德二世的儿子。在这里度过了他的童年和青少年时期，接受了良好的教育和军事训练。作为省长的儿子，他学习了行政管理、军事战略和伊斯兰教义，为日后的统治奠定了基础。这段时期培养了他坚定的宗教信仰和军事才能，同时也塑造了他果断甚至冷酷的性格特质。
points.descriptionEn: Selim was born in Trabzon as the son of Bayezid II. He spent his childhood and adolescence here, receiving excellent education and military training. As the son of a provincial governor, he studied administration, military strategy, and Islamic doctrines, laying the foundation for his future reign. This period fostered his strong religious faith and military abilities, while also shaping his decisive and even ruthless character traits.

points.placeEn: Various provinces of the Ottoman Empire
points.title: 省督生涯
points.description: 成为省督后，塞利姆被派往帝国各地任职，包括希瓦斯、马尼萨和科尼亚等地。在这些省份，他积累了丰富的行政和军事经验，同时建立了自己的政治势力。他通过镇压叛乱和扩张领土展示了军事才能，但也因手段残酷而获得'严酷者'的绰号。这段经历使他认识到奥斯曼帝国面临的内外挑战，特别是萨法维王朝的崛起和帝国边境的安全问题。
points.descriptionEn: After becoming a governor, Selim was appointed to various provinces across the empire, including Sivas, Manisa, and Konya. In these provinces, he accumulated extensive administrative and military experience while building his own political power. He demonstrated his military capabilities by suppressing rebellions and expanding territories, but also earned the nickname 'the Grim' for his ruthless methods. This period made him aware of the internal and external challenges facing the Ottoman Empire, particularly the rise of the Safavid dynasty and border security issues.

points.title: 夺取王位
points.description: 1512年，塞利姆在近卫军的支持下，通过政变迫使父亲巴耶济德二世退位，自己登上苏丹之位。在埃迪尔内，他迅速巩固了权力，清除潜在威胁，包括处决或流放多位兄弟和亲戚。这一时期，他开始实施一系列军事改革，加强军队组织，为即将到来的大规模战争做准备。他的统治方式以铁腕著称，但也为奥斯曼帝国带来了稳定和秩序。
points.descriptionEn: In 1512, with the support of the Janissaries, Selim forced his father Bayezid II to abdicate through a coup and ascended to the throne. In Edirne, he quickly consolidated power by eliminating potential threats, including executing or exiling several brothers and relatives. During this period, he began implementing a series of military reforms, strengthening the army organization in preparation for the upcoming large-scale wars. His rule was characterized by an iron fist, but it brought stability and order to the Ottoman Empire.

points.title: 东征萨法维
points.description: 塞利姆将注意力转向东方，针对迅速崛起的萨法维王朝发动军事行动。1514年，他在查尔迪兰战役中击败了萨法维王朝的伊斯玛仪一世，这场胜利确立了奥斯曼帝国在安纳托利亚的霸权。随后他占领了萨法维王朝的首都大不里士，并将什叶派宗教领袖和大量什叶派民众驱逐到奥斯曼帝国。这一系列行动不仅巩固了奥斯曼帝国在东部边境的安全，也确立了逊尼派伊斯兰教在帝国的主导地位。
points.descriptionEn: Selim turned his attention to the east, launching military campaigns against the rapidly rising Safavid dynasty. In 1514, he defeated Ismail I of the Safavid dynasty at the Battle of Chaldiran, a victory that established Ottoman hegemony in Anatolia. He then captured the Safavid capital of Tabriz and exiled the Shia religious leaders and a large number of Shia Muslims to the Ottoman Empire. These actions not only secured the Ottoman Empire's eastern borders but also established the dominance of Sunni Islam within the empire.

points.title: 征服马穆鲁克
points.description: 塞利姆将目光投向南方，开始对马穆鲁克王朝的军事行动。1516-1517年间，他先后在达比克和里达尼亚战役中击败马穆鲁克军队，征服了大马士革、耶路撒冷、开罗等重要城市。他将哈里发的头衔纳入奥斯曼苏丹的名号中，成为伊斯兰世界的最高宗教领袖。这次征服不仅使奥斯曼帝国控制了阿拉伯半岛、埃及和北非，还获得了控制印度洋贸易路线的战略优势，极大地扩展了帝国的版图和影响力。
points.descriptionEn: Selim set his sights on the south, beginning military campaigns against the Mamluk Sultanate. Between 1516-1517, he defeated the Mamluk forces at the battles of Marj Dabiq and Ridaniya, conquering important cities such as Damascus, Jerusalem, and Cairo. He incorporated the title of Caliph into the Ottoman Sultan's titles, becoming the supreme religious leader of the Islamic world. This conquest not only brought the Arabian Peninsula, Egypt, and North Africa under Ottoman control but also gave the empire strategic advantages in controlling Indian Ocean trade routes, significantly expanding the empire's territory and influence.

supporter.zh: 塞利姆一世被奥斯曼历史学家誉为'严酷者'，但也是一位伟大的扩张者和改革者。他通过军事征服将奥斯曼帝国版图扩大了一倍，控制了伊斯兰世界的圣地和贸易路线。他加强中央集权，推行军事改革，建立了高效的行政体系，为苏莱曼大帝的黄金时代奠定了基础。作为'两圣地监护人'，他巩固了奥斯曼帝国在伊斯兰世界中的领导地位，确保了帝国的长期稳定和繁荣。
supporter.en: Selim I is revered by Ottoman historians as 'the Grim', but also as a great conqueror and reformer. He doubled the Ottoman Empire's territory through military conquests, gaining control over Islamic holy sites and trade routes. He strengthened central authority, implemented military reforms, and established an efficient administrative system, laying the foundation for Suleiman the Magnificent's golden age. As the 'Guardian of the Two Holy Cities', he solidified the Ottoman Empire's leadership in the Islamic world, ensuring the empire's long-term stability and prosperity.

critic.zh: 批评者认为塞利姆一世的统治以极端暴力和残酷著称，他通过处决兄弟和亲戚清除潜在威胁，建立了恐怖统治。他对萨法维王朝和什叶派的迫害导致长期宗教冲突，加剧了伊斯兰世界的分裂。他的军事扩张虽然扩大了帝国版图，但也耗尽了国家资源，为后来的财政危机埋下隐患。此外，他过度依赖军事手段解决政治问题，忽视了国内经济发展和文化建设，使奥斯曼帝国走上了军事扩张的道路。
critic.en: Critics argue that Selim I's rule was characterized by extreme violence and cruelty. He eliminated potential threats by executing brothers and relatives, establishing a reign of terror. His persecution of the Safavid dynasty and Shia Muslims led to long-term religious conflicts, exacerbating divisions within the Islamic world. Although his military expansions enlarged the empire's territory, they exhausted national resources and laid the groundwork for future financial crises. Moreover, he relied excessively on military solutions to political problems, neglecting domestic economic development and cultural construction, leading the Ottoman Empire down a path of military expansion.

objective.zh: 从历史学角度看，塞利姆一世是一位复杂而关键的历史人物，他重塑了奥斯曼帝国的地缘政治格局。他通过军事征服和宗教政策，将奥斯曼帝国转变为一个横跨欧亚非三大洲的超级大国。他的统治标志着奥斯曼帝国从一个区域性力量向世界帝国的转变。在流行文化中，他常被描绘为冷酷无情的军事天才，但也被视为伊斯兰世界的捍卫者。他的遗产既有领土扩张和军事成就，也有宗教迫害和内部暴力的争议，体现了历史人物的多面性和时代局限性。
objective.en: From a historical perspective, Selim I was a complex and pivotal figure who reshaped the geopolitical landscape of the Ottoman Empire. Through military conquests and religious policies, he transformed the Ottoman Empire into a superpower spanning three continents. His reign marked the empire's transition from a regional power to a world empire. In popular culture, he is often depicted as a ruthless military genius but also as a defender of the Islamic world. His legacy includes both territorial expansion and military achievements, as well as controversies surrounding religious persecution and internal violence, reflecting the multifaceted nature and historical limitations of the man.

self.zh: 我宁愿统治一个小的王国，也不愿在一个大的王国中做奴隶。
self.en: I would rather rule a small kingdom than be a slave in a large one.

others.zh: 塞利姆是一位伟大的征服者，他使奥斯曼帝国成为伊斯兰世界的领袖，但也以他的残酷手段留下了黑暗的遗产。
others.en: Selim was a great conqueror who made the Ottoman Empire the leader of the Islamic world, but he also left a dark legacy with his ruthless methods.
